description: This is a Go source file implementing a CLI tool 'mcpcurl' that interacts with an MCP server via JSON-RPC over stdio. It dynamically loads tool schemas, generates commands, and handles JSON responses with optional pretty printing.

classes.name: SchemaResponse
classes.description: Top-level response containing list of tools from MCP server

classes.name: Tool
classes.description: Represents a command with schema details

classes.name: InputSchema
classes.description: Defines input parameters schema for a tool

classes.name: Property
classes.description: Defines a single input parameter's type and constraints

classes.name: RequestParams
classes.description: Contains tool name and arguments for JSON-RPC

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Response content item with type and text

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Full response structure including result and metadata

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point initializing CLI, loading schema, and generating commands

methods.name: addCommandFromTool
methods.description: Creates a CLI command from a tool schema and adds it to the parent command

methods.name: buildArgumentsMap
methods.description: Extracts CLI flag values into a map of arguments for JSON-RPC

methods.name: buildJSONRPCRequest
methods.description: Constructs a JSON-RPC request string with method, tool name, and arguments

methods.name: executeServerCommand
methods.description: Runs the specified shell command, sends JSON request via stdin, and captures stdout

methods.name: printResponse
methods.description: Pretty prints or outputs the raw response JSON, handling nested text content
